scope: Bounded learner-facing sense plan for the fifteen deliberate Urdu B1 Unit 1 targets. Exact freshness across canonical Urdu A1+A2 is rechecked fail-closed by the promotion workflow before any B1 canonical write. This is not educator/publication release approval.
architecture_reference: Completed French B1 Unit 1 calibration uses 3 new targets in P1-P5 and zero new targets in P6; Urdu B1 mirrors that B1 load while remaining independently written.

targets.intended_sense: practical; based on doing or application rather than explanation alone
targets.external_check: Rekhta: عمل سے منسوب یا متعلق، کام کا

targets.intended_sense: discovery or finding reached by investigation or observation
targets.external_check: Rekhta dictionary supports investigation/recognition and discovered/found senses

targets.intended_sense: clarification or explanation that makes an idea clearer
targets.external_check: Rekhta: صاف ظاہر کرنا، نمایاں کرنا; clarification/refinement

targets.intended_sense: balance between two demands, activities, or priorities
improvement; movement to a better condition
a span or period of time
according to; in agreement with a rule, plan, or evidence
made available or provided for use
obtaining or attaining something through effort or process
research or systematic investigation used to answer a question
average; a value representing the central level of several numerical results
overall or aggregate, considering the whole rather than one part
academic degree awarded after completing a program of study
situation; the set of current conditions affecting a decision or problem
entered or recorded in a list, form, record, or system

generation_policy.p1_to_p5: three deliberate new lexical targets each, matching B1 calibration load
generation_policy.p6: zero deliberate new lexical targets; cumulative checkpoint
generation_policy.target_word_band: roughly 230-300 words with connected multi-paragraph reasoning
generation_policy.assessment: 10 questions and 10 linked answers with multi-sentence inference, motive, grammar-in-context, vocabulary, and synthesis
